mentions.name: Shaarli-to-GitHub bookmarks sync CLI
mentions.description: A CLI tool that syncs bookmarks saved in Shaarli to the author's public GitHub bookmarks repository, automating the manual upkeep of that popular (500+ star) repo.
mentions.problem: The author lost interest in manually maintaining his awesome-list bookmarks repo after moving his bookmarks to Shaarli
mentions.audience: The author, maintaining his own bookmark collection
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm coding a CLI tool to automate the work of syncing my shaarli links to my public "popular" (+500 stars) repo at https://github.com/SansGuidon/bookmarks
